phases.name: Verify the accepted baseline
phases.objective: Verify the frozen source release and rerun the existing bounded engineering/reference checks without replacing their historical output files.
criteria: Frozen release input hashes still match; independent corpus verification passes.
Existing bounded suites run successfully; their scopes are preserved.
No manuscript, source corpus or historical release evidence is overwritten.

phases.name: Prepare source-context and availability work records
phases.objective: Create one source-grounded work record for each accepted report, preserving version identity, basis evidence, source locations and unresolved availability/package/semantic obligations.
criteria: Exactly the accepted report IDs occur once, with original and extraction hashes verified.
Sourced filing dates remain distinct from unknown publication and byte-vintage evidence.
No record is promoted to a gold accounting label or complete disclosure package.

phases.name: Complete the bounded Apple case preparation
phases.objective: Build a source-anchored annual/interim Apple case layer over the existing retained files: every inventoried note has an explicit modelling disposition, selected statement/note bridges are machine-checked, external incorporations remain visible, and known unidentified histories are preserved. Implement reusable extraction/context/reconciliation code rather than copying authored conclusions.
criteria: All 13 annual and 10 interim notes have source anchors, linked quantities or explicit unresolved meaning, with no claim that dispositions alone close semantics.
Reconciliation uses source-bound values and exact rounding-aware expectations; wrong scale/sign/perimeter and broken source anchors are rejected.
Incorporated proxy/agreement and publication-version obligations are investigated using legitimate public sources where available, and unresolved obligations are specific.
Tests include real retained input and independent arithmetic/source checks; no full-company forecast is claimed.

phases.name: Implement source lowering and shared IR
phases.objective: Implement executable DSL source-to-IR lowering and an equivalent typed-library entrypoint for the declared Core 0 supported profile. Start with borrowing.acc and expand beyond an exact fixture lookup. Preserve package bindings, source context, assumptions and alternatives. Never label a JSON/schema parser as a semantic compiler.
criteria: Actual source programs lower through parsing, binding, package/type/context checks into validated shared IR.
Equivalent typed-library programs have matching semantics and changed valid inputs produce changed results rather than returning a frozen fixture.
Independent source variants and schema-valid negative programs test supported coverage and unsupported-operation errors.
Outstanding general-language, mapping and uncertainty support is explicitly enumerated; no full G2 closure by one profile.

phases.name: Implement reconstruction and numerical operations
phases.objective: Implement declared-template joint constraint construction and bounded rational/finite-choice reconstruction. Preserve linked alternatives, rounding, integer cases, strict endpoint attainment, infeasibility/unknown/resource limits and model scope. Use exact known-history fixtures and independent oracles.
criteria: Construct constraints from inputs rather than hand-entered final answers; exact small family results agree with independent enumeration.
Rounding, strict endpoints, integer restrictions, contradictory evidence and unsupported operations have tested semantics.
Query results preserve joint dependence, unfinished branches and honest completeness within stated scope.
Continuous/nonlinear inference or arbitrary-history completeness is not inferred from these tests.

phases.name: Execute the bounded company path
phases.objective: Build an executable Northstar economic-event -> state/journal -> statements path using the existing known-history cases. Produce balance sheet, income/OCI, cash-flow and equity outputs from common journals; preserve event failures and supported scenario/history branches. Apply a supported bounded path to the prepared real case without inventing absent facts.
criteria: Run actual event inputs, not the expected-result fixture; independently check journals and all statement bridges.
Atomic rejection, duplicate events, economic funding default and unsupported operations have distinct outputs.
Role/date information checks stop future-data use in supported behaviour and measurement paths.
Real-company conditional calculations and any unresolved operation remain distinct from forecast accuracy and semantic completeness.

phases.name: Enforce context, chronology and resolution
phases.objective: Implement context-aware mappings, partition checks, original/latest/harmonised evidence selection, category-specific uncertainty admission and query-dependent resolution checks for bounded supported cases; test their interactions.
criteria: Parent/group and basis mismatches, overlapping dimensions and unsupported measurement conversion are rejected.
Valid/invalid YTD subtraction, selective revisions, date-only policies and unknown source availability are tested.
Every supported uncertainty category has appropriate admission rules; unimplemented categories fail explicitly.
Changing horizon/scenario triggers grouping sufficiency checks; approximation needs declared error evidence.

phases.name: Implement review, persistence and recovery
phases.objective: Implement local evidence review transitions and persistent transactional company execution, immutable lineage, idempotent recovery and versioned migration. Preserve prior results under their original evidence views and invalidate dependent results after corrections.
criteria: Interrupted execution and replay match uninterrupted execution for the declared scope.
Duplicate/conflicting events, partial writes and migrations have tested failure and recovery behaviour.
Review correction invalidates the transitive dependents while preserving unrelated and historical results.
Stable branch/event identities and stochastic-stream requirements are implemented or explicitly unsupported.

phases.name: Resolve authority and corporate-method obligations
phases.objective: Prepare dated primary-authority support and implement or precisely specify the next supported corporate/financing operations: revenue, tax, leases, FX, complex groups and bonds. Inspect legitimate primary ASC/ASBE/IFRS-related authority and adopted research; preserve access blocks and jurisdiction limits. Choose a complete internally supportable operation slice and leave the wider queue visible.
criteria: Claims have inspected primary paragraph/section anchors and jurisdiction/effective-period limits; unavailable texts remain uninspected.
A supported operation slice has preconditions, recognition, measurement, state/posting effects, note links and exact multi-period cases.
Same-fact cross-standard comparisons explain supported differences; source absence is not silently replaced by company practice.
Missing methods and material unresolved interpretations are recorded as specific follow-up work; no professional engagement or paid data.

phases.name: Extend bank methods
phases.objective: Develop the next source-supported bank allowance/credit lifecycle and funding/capital operation slice, using the retained bank filings and exact synthetic cases. Explicitly separate IFRS 9/CECL and jurisdictional prudential requirements, deposits/funding/liquidity and management behaviour.
criteria: Inspect and archive legitimate primary support for each adopted method and period.
Multi-period cases reconcile allowance/accounting movements and separately justified capital quantities.
Illustrative prudential numbers are not promoted to actual jurisdictional rules.
Remaining lifecycle, calibration and regulatory coverage is listed with an executable next slice.

phases.name: Extend insurance methods
phases.objective: Extend the short-duration insurer case through an internally supportable next operation slice toward general measurement, CSM, variable fees, transition, onerous groups and risk adjustment. Preserve separate gross/reinsurance recognition, eligibility, timing and asset interactions; inspect technical actuarial methods.
criteria: Source-backed selected measurement/roll-forward operations have complete exact multi-period examples.
Reinsurance eligibility/timing and risk-transfer/nonperformance effects remain separate.
Risk-adjustment estimation is supported by a defined uncertainty method or left explicitly open.
CSM, variable-fee, transition and onerous-group gaps retain specific follow-up tasks when not implemented.

phases.name: Exercise adapters and matched frontends
phases.objective: Exercise selected pinned Arelle, ACTUS, QuantLib, Docling and ledger interfaces on retained bounded inputs, using only available or project-local open-source dependencies. Build reproducible adapter exchanges and compare the DSL and typed frontend on the same shared model/tasks.
criteria: Each attempted adapter records exact version, actual executable input/output, unit/calendar conventions and failures.
Unavailable tools stay unavailable; inspection or import-only checks are not represented as completed integration.
Matched frontend semantic tests share the same model, accounting methods and runtime.
No human authoring/usability superiority is inferred without a separate study.

phases.name: Prepare and exercise a bounded benchmark
phases.objective: Build task-specific provisional reference records, admissible-answer rules, exposure-aware splits, difficult-case inventory and actual workload measurements. Execute a bounded evaluated task only when its reference answers and scoring protocol are ready; keep nine issuer families and longitudinal dependence explicit.
criteria: Predeclare task denominators, error/failure treatment and uncertainty before scoring.
Reference records preserve ambiguity and unresolved cases and do not adopt evaluated-model answers as truth.
Source-QA exposure, finance/insurance-heavy proposed test families, duplicates and issuer/time dependence are disclosed.
Measure facts/constraints/branches, memory/runtime and graceful failure; source page counts are not capacity evidence.
No statistical ranking, broad accounting validity or clean heldout status without supporting evidence.

phases.name: Develop calibrated forecasting methods and evidence
phases.objective: Prepare and execute the smallest defensible calibration/forecast diagnostic using eligible evidenced source vintages and transparent operating assumptions. Define the target, matched naive/credible tuned baselines, uncertainty analysis and target-specific inference protocol before empirical work. Continue source/method preparation when chronology vetoes a historical test.
criteria: Research intent, default audit, baseline, promotion/veto rules, nonclaims and run manifest are written before empirical runs.
Historical tests use no later information and no unknown availability assumptions.
Joint weights/inference and unresolved probability mass are handled under an explicit justified measure.
Limited diagnostics do not establish forecast superiority, causal identification or continuous-inference validity.

phases.name: Integrate the design and independent-review preparation
phases.objective: Integrate supported implementation and method findings into the governing design, inspect the rendered manuscript, and update the master requirement/gap evidence and resume notes. Preserve equations, citations and source limits. Prepare narrow unsent review packets only for consequential internally exhausted judgments.
criteria: Rendered manuscript and source changes are inspected against the protected baseline with substantive omissions explained.
Specification, implementation, accounting, forecast and human-comprehension status stay distinct.
All eighteen gap categories and MC01–MC35 retain honest residual work and next actions.
No paid engagement, publication, external messages or generic human-review stop blocks independent internal work.
